About Us

A specialized BIM & engineering partner.

BIM Infotech Pvt. Ltd. operates as a specialized service provider and consultancy focused on BIM modeling, MEP coordination, structural modeling, CAD drafting, Revit content development, 3D scanning and technical training.

Our objective is simple: produce accurate, coordinated deliverables for clients and give students practical skills that connect academic learning with industry expectations.
